claims: Tomislav Ivisic and Zvonimir Ivisic are Croatian twin brothers.
Tomislav Ivisic and Zvonimir Ivisic play for the University of Illinois in the 2025–26 season.
Zvonimir Ivisic and Tomislav Ivisic were born on August 9, 2003.
Zvonimir Ivisic and Tomislav Ivisic were born in Vitez, Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Zvonimir Ivisic and Tomislav Ivisic grew up playing together in Croatia and Montenegro.
Zvonimir Ivisic played at Kentucky during the 2023–2024 season.
Zvonimir Ivisic transferred to the University of Illinois.
Tomislav Ivisic joined the University of Illinois prior to the 2024–25 season.
Tomislav Ivisic and Zvonimir Ivisic had previous stints in European professional leagues.
Zvonimir Ivisic played for Kentucky and Arkansas.
Tomislav Ivisic and Zvonimir Ivisic reunited at the University of Illinois after attending separate US collegiate teams.
